classifiedFinding.title: Zero set-aside buffer on the sDOLA destination departs from story 091 Decision 6 / story 082 Phase 4 with no authorising story

classification.assetImpact: None. No asset, value or availability impact. Zero buffer on the sDOLA destination is the safer choice under Law 1: the fork harness (work/test/audit-run37/SdolaZeroBuffer.fork.t.sol, 5/5 pass, reproduced) shows V2 on the sDOLA strategy cannot go below par without an owner emergencyWithdraw, and a 10% pct would idle ~10% of DOLA yield recoverable only by rescueERC20.
classification.likelihood: n/a - traceability defect, not an exploit
classification.assumptions: Story tree at ~/code/product-owner/stories/phStaging2 (latest 097) has no story recording the zero-buffer decision; commit 1349be8 has no [story-NNN] tag.

quotes: Read V1's buffer pct from the source strategy and apply it to the destination for V2 (`setSetAsideBuffer(V2, pct)`).
V2's buffer pct on the destination = V1's pct read from the source in Phase 0.

classifiedFinding.justification: A pure behavioural deviation from stories 091 (Decision 6) and 082 (Phase 4) with no security impact. Under Law 2 it goes to the spec-conformance report as F-class at Low; it must not be bundled with QA/gas items. The deviation is the safer behaviour, so the fix is to the spec, not the code.
classifiedFinding.recommendation: Keep the code. Write a story or decision record that amends 091 Decision 6 and 082 Phase 4 (L73) to say that V2's set-aside buffer pct on the sDOLA destination is 0, with the monotone-rate / no-yield-diversion rationale already in the _targetBufferPct NatSpec (L2094-2101). Tag the commit that lands it. Optionally note the 082 L172 'DOLA 10%' result as superseded.

classifiedFinding.title: package.json runbook comment still says the set-aside buffer pct is 'copied from V1's source' for every token

classification.assetImpact: None. The script asserts the correct target (0 for DOLA) in Phase 4, Phase 8 and the verifier, and nothing on chain reads this text.

classifiedFinding.justification: Documentation drift in the operator runbook (package.json L49 still says 'set-aside buffer pct copied from V1's source'; confirmed at 1349be8). At worst an operator mistakes the correct DOLA 0% log line for a failure. That is a comment/documentation issue, which C4 treats as QA/Low. It is not F-class, because the story deviation itself is covered by R37-CUT-01. The sanitizer's flag on rootCauseClass naming stands: keep StaleRunbookDoc so the fingerprint does not collide with the fixed Q-02 1c859cdebb64.
classifiedFinding.recommendation: Change package.json L49 to: 'set-aside buffer pct copied from V1's source (USDC/USDe); ZERO on the sDOLA destination (DOLA)', so it matches the script NatSpec at L68-73.

classifiedFinding.title: With V2's sDOLA set-aside buffer at 0, initiateMigration's balance-measured R has no idle top-up, so a future V2 terminal migration off the sDOLA strategy can realise R a few wei below P from floored share redemption

classification.assetImpact: A few wei of DOLA, spread pro-rata across DOLA stakers, at a future V2 terminal migration off the sDOLA strategy. It cannot happen in this cutover.
classification.likelihood: low. Needs a future V2 DOLA initiateMigration and a floored share-to-asset redeem that lands under booked principal. Neither is attacker-steerable.
classification.assumptions: Reasoned from source (StableStakerV2.initiateMigration L838-842, R = min(balanceOf, P)). Not measured on a fork. The sDOLA strategy's own rounding is claimed to keep V >= td, which may make the shortfall zero in practice.

classifiedFinding.justification: Rounding dust with no attack path is QA under the C4 dust/rounding rule. It is not an owner footgun: the consequence is wei-scale and does not break a story's security property. The old 10% buffer would only have covered exits of up to ~8 DOLA/yr of accrued cushion anyway, at the cost of idling ~10% of yield. Because it is unmeasured, it stays at the lowest tier.
classifiedFinding.recommendation: Accept and document; no code change. A non-zero DOLA pct is NOT warranted to cover wei dust, because it would divert ~10% of DOLA yield. If a cushion is wanted before a future V2 DOLA initiateMigration, transfer a nominal amount of DOLA straight to V2 (the idle balance R reads), as the _targetBufferPct NatSpec suggests. Record this in the story written for R37-CUT-01.
